form.addDescription: The hub seals the value and never shows it again, not even to you. Runs of the projects you choose get it on your workers.

form.name: Name

kinds.gitHint: Git's credential helper answers with it for the origins under a URL prefix, such as a GitLab access token.

form.envVarHint: Upper case letters, digits and underscores. Not PATH, HOME, SHELL, USER, TMPDIR or SSH_AUTH_SOCK, and no name starting with EVO_, GIT_, LD_, DYLD_ or PYTHON.
form.urlPrefixHint: The https address the origins start with, without a user or a password. git@ and ssh:// origins on the same host and path match it too.
form.usernameHint: What git sends with the value; {user} when left empty, as GitLab takes with an access token.
form.projectsHint: Only projects where you hold the writer role are listed.

form.workersHint: Check none for any of your workers, or some to keep it to them.
form.noWorkers: You have no worker yet: the secret goes to any worker you register.
form.expiresHint: Optional. No run gets it from 00:00 UTC of that day, the way GitLab ends an access token on its expiry date.
form.valueHint: Sent once over HTTPS and sealed by the hub; this page forgets it as soon as it is sent.
form.valueReplaceHint: The new value, or the same one again; this page forgets it as soon as it is sent.
form.valueOneLine: One line, as git's credential protocol takes it.
form.valueLines: One line here; a value of several lines goes in with evo-agents hub secret set, from stdin.
form.valueForgotten: The value was not kept: paste it again before you retry.
form.warning: The agent of a run reads this value in clear and could leak it. Give a token with only the rights its runs need, and an end date.
form.addedText: The hub sealed its value and will not show it again.
form.replacedText: Runs that ask for their credentials from now on get the new value.

problems.urlPrefixInvalid: An https address with a host and a path, without a query or a fragment, such as https://gitlab.example.org/group.
problems.urlPrefixCredentials: No user or password in the address: the user goes in Username, the token in Value.
problems.usernameInvalid: One line of at most 200 characters.
problems.expiresPast: Pick a day after today: a secret ends in the future.
